evaluation_policy.all_source_label_concordance: Report ranks for every frozen case, including both flagged cases. Name this concordance with source-curated labels, never diagnostic accuracy or clinical validation.
evaluation_policy.provisionally_usable_truth_subset: Ten cases other than PAX4 and ZIC3. This is a pre-execution sensitivity subset, not a clean clinical gold standard: the other original case publications have not all been independently re-adjudicated. Retain and show both flagged cases separately; do not silently drop them or replace any execution failures.
evaluation_policy.phenotype_controls: Retain all frozen original/half_missing/swapped/none arms unchanged, including donor assignments. Swapped and none are synthetic perturbations, not healthy or genuinely unsolved cases.
evaluation_policy.claim_limit: Externally authored case phenotypes and curated variants, with synthesized spike/background input, demonstrate pipeline behavior across genes and genotype structures. They do not measure prospective diagnostic accuracy or drug rescue. Leakage into HPO/OMIM/ClinVar/pathogenicity resources remains possible.

flagged_cases.reason: The source paper's own genetic-results section classifies this variant as of unknown clinical significance, reports the same variant in an unaffected father, and contradicts its introductory de-novo statement. The dataset nevertheless encodes SOLVED/CAUSATIVE. A gene-level primary genetic-evidence study challenges PAX4 as a monogenic MODY cause. Thus a high PAX4 rank must not be counted as a confirmed correct diagnosis, and a low rank is not unambiguous diagnostic failure.

sources.location: Methods, Results, Discussion; three structured tables

flagged_cases.bounds: The older gene-level study has ancestry/power limitations; this is a disputed-label flag, not a new patient diagnosis or a claim that every PAX4 variant has been disproved.

flagged_cases.reason: The same public phenopacket marks both HP:0001746 Asplenia and HP:0001748 Polysplenia as present. We preserve this source conflict rather than guessing which term belongs to the individual. The original report has not been fully read to resolve it.
